title.narrative: Promoting and Protecting Inclusive, Equitable and Safe Sport and Physical Education (PE)

description.narrative: UNESCO supports Member States in developing and implementing inclusive, equitable and safe sport and physical education policies, in line with the International Charter for Physical Education, Physical Activity and Sport. Powered by the Fit for Life Sport Alliance, this workplan combines action on evidence-based policy making, capacity-building, and advocacy. Key activities include the development and refinement of Global Policy Standards through consultations with Member States and survivors of violence, the creation of digital tools to support implementation and monitoring, and advocacy efforts promoting the fight against racism, disability inclusion, gender equality and safe sport. Main deliverables include the Global Policy Standards, integrated digital tools, and targeted advocacy initiatives to strengthen policy effectiveness and investment.
